question: Does the already measured two-mean ranking flip select a lower real terminal reward at the forecast's actual30-control horizon?

known_before_execution.unknown: Controls16..30 of each full query1 mean were not executed open loop in the source native pair; query2 replanned after15 controls. Their30-control open-loop terminal rewards and states are unknown before this replay.

root.reconstruction: Use existing CPU bootstrap/reconstruct_and_snapshot helper, original cfg_for/make_env, cached mechanical state/target/history and saved mjSTATE_INTEGRATION. Constructor-internal initialization is disclosed separately; no explicit reset, expert rollout or extra warmup.
root.initial_gate: Exact cached initial render/proprio, complete integration state, site positions and saved physical snapshot; no tolerance relaxation.

candidates.decode: Reshape original full mean to30x4 and call native Preprocessor.denormalize_actions in CPU float32 using source summary.strict_load.normalization. Execute these unchanged physical actions, including the original raw saturation; no new alias branch.
candidates.policy: Open loop for30 controls; no CEM, encoder, predictor, rescoring, replanning, new candidate or seed.
candidates.prefix_gate: For each candidate, controls1..15 must exactly reproduce its source trace action/reward/state/physical/pixels/success/distance/termination/counters. On the first mismatch stop the entire replay, preserve partial output, and do not continue controls16..30 or the next candidate.

metrics.primary: Actual native terminal reward after30 controls; canonical-selected candidate1 minus original-selected candidate0.
metrics.comparison: Keep the already observed score matrix and selected indices fixed. Report negative, zero and positive real utility differences without retuning or selecting candidates. No oracle-optimality gate.

runtime.stop: Technical failure, timeout, any prefix/root mismatch or simulator exception: preserve partial evidence and stop. Partial is not task failure; no automatic retry or seed replacement.

endpoint_schema: Separate endpoint15.npz and endpoint30.npz: pixels uint8[1,3,224,224], proprio float32[1,4], state, tcp, target, control_offset. Add one leading time axis for a later native encode; this run does not encode either endpoint.
interpretation: A post hoc two-candidate diagnostic on one already known development root. Aligns true consequence horizon with the frozen score horizon; not a full CEM-population ranking audit, closed-loop mediation, new attack success rate, GoalSwap result, independent generalization or defense. No predicted score substitutes for measured utility.
